para.verbatim:
embed:rst This class inherits from :cpp:class:`BaseLogger` The command-line view: a logger that displays its output on a ``std::ostream`` and takes its input from a ``std::istream`` -- the console by default :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` .. note:: This is the view for a *plain C++* consumer of the core. The `pybind11`_ ``Logger`` is deliberately **not** this class -- it is its own :cpp:class:`BaseLogger` subclass that writes through `Python`_'s ``print``/``input`` instead (see ``py/src/view/PyLogger.h``), so that its output interleaves correctly with `Python`_'s own buffered ``sys.stdout`` and so the unit tester's ``builtins.print``/``builtins.input`` patches still see it
